title: "Method"
subtitle: "What each step is for, and which methods, packages and models it uses"
toc-depth: 2

```{python}
import _lib as L

cfg = L.config()
ver = L.run_meta().get("wersje", {})
m6, m7 = L.metrics("pule_6"), L.metrics("pseudoslowa_7")
k, llm, p = cfg["kandydaci"], cfg["llm"], cfg["pseudoslowa"]
num, M = L.fmt, L.model
v = lambda name: f"{name} {ver[name]}" if name in ver else name
T = lambda rows, heads: L.table(rows, heads, "l" * len(heads))
m1, m2 = (M(x) for x in llm["modele_porownywane"][:2])
judge = M(llm["model_rozstrzygajacy"])
```

Thresholds and model names on this page are read from
[`config/biologia_sp.yaml`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/config/biologia_sp.yaml).
One command runs all steps: `python -m jutro run --config config/biologia_sp.yaml --probka 50`.

## Models

```{python}
T([
    ("Label every candidate, twice and independently", f"{m1}, {m2}", "5"),
    ("Settle disagreements and low-confidence cases", judge, "5"),
    ("Group terms into concepts", M(llm.get("model_pojec")), "5"),
    ("List terms directly from the materials (check on step 4)", M(llm["model_ekstrakcji"]), "5"),
    ("Generate pseudowords", M(llm["model_pseudoslow"]), "7"),
    ("Rate pseudowords", M(llm["model_oceny_pseudoslow"]), "7"),
    ("Lemmatise, as two of the tools compared in the benchmark", ", ".join(M(x) for x in llm.get("lematyzacja_modele", [])), "2"),
], ["Task", "Model", "Step"])
```

All requests go through the Claude Batch API (`{python} v("anthropic")`) with JSON-schema output.

## 1 · Corpus {#corpus}

**Why:** subject words stand out only against the text of other subjects.

```{python}
T([
    ("Target", f"materials of the subject `{cfg['cel']['przedmiot']}`, school stage `{cfg['cel']['etap_kod']}`", "ZPE dump"),
    ("Contrast", "materials of all other subjects of the same stage, without foreign languages; six per target material in a sample run", "ZPE dump"),
    ("Text", "HTML parsed into titles, body, definitions, exercises, captions", v("lxml")),
    ("Cleaning", f"sentences repeated in at least {cfg['czyszczenie']['szablon_min_materialow']} materials, interface instructions "
                 "and licence lines are removed", "own rules"),
], ["What", "How", "Tool"])
```

## 2 · Tagging and lemmatisation {#tagging}

**Why:** Polish inflects, so counting words needs their base forms.

```{python}
T([
    ("Lemma and part of speech", "spaCy tags each token; the Morfeusz2 reading that agrees with spaCy gives the lemma",
     f"{v('spacy')} (`{cfg['narzedzia']['spacy_model']}`), {v('morfeusz2')}"),
    ("Check", f"300 forms, mostly rare terms and phrases; spaCy and Stanza, each with and without Morfeusz2, Morfeusz2 alone, "
              f"{' and '.join(M(x) for x in llm.get('lematyzacja_modele', []))}", v("stanza")),
], ["What", "How", "Tool"])
```

## 3 · Frequencies {#frequency}

**Why:** general frequency tells a rare term from an everyday word, and it is what matching uses later.

```{python}
T([
    ("Used in the lists", "KWJP100 lemma frequencies, on the Zipf scale", "KWJP100 (CC BY 4.0)"),
    ("Compared only", "coverage of the biology vocabulary and agreement with KWJP100", f"NKJP, SUBTLEX-PL, {v('wordfreq')}"),
], ["What", "How", "Resource"])
```

## 4 · Candidates {#candidates}

**Why:** a complete and repeatable list of everything that could be a term, made before any model is involved.

```{python}
T([
    ("Single words", "lemmas of content words known to Morfeusz2; proper names dropped", "own code"),
    ("Phrases", f"noun phrases of 2–{k['max_dlugosc']} words found by syntactic patterns (adjective + noun, noun + genitive), "
                "rebuilt in the nominative", "own code (`frazy.py`)"),
    ("Subject candidates", f"at least {k['min_frekw_cel']} occurrences in at least {k['min_materialow']} biology materials, or at "
                           f"least {k['min_frekw_jeden_material']} in one", ""),
    ("General candidates", f"at least {k['ogolne_min_frekw']} occurrences across at least {k['ogolne_min_przedmiotow']} other subjects", ""),
    ("Scores", "log-likelihood and log ratio against the contrast corpus and against KWJP100, Simple Maths, TF-IDF across "
               "subjects, PMI and logDice for phrases, C-value, rank fusion of all of them", "own code; C-value from TermoPL 8.1.1"),
], ["What", "How", "Tool"])
```

The scores rank candidates and are compared with each other on the [Results](results.qmd#extraction) page. They do
not decide the labels: all subject candidates (up to `{python} num(k["top_do_llm"])`) and a stratified sample of
`{python} num(k["ogolne_do_llm"])` general candidates go to the models.

## 5 · Labels {#labels}

**Why:** statistics cannot tell a biology term from a school word that happens to be frequent in biology.

```{python}
T([
    ("The model sees", "the candidate, its counts in biology and in the other subjects, up to three sentences from the corpus"),
    ("The model returns", "a label, a corrected base form if needed, whether the term can be shown in a picture, its confidence, a one-sentence reason"),
    ("Labels", "`T3` biology term · `T3_INNY` term of another subject · `T2` school vocabulary · `T1` everyday word · `SZUM` not usable"),
    ("Final label", f"the label of {m1} and {m2} if they agree and are confident; otherwise {judge} votes too and the majority of "
                    "three decides; no majority → marked for review"),
    ("Concepts", f"{M(llm.get('model_pojec'))} groups variants, synonyms and derivatives of one concept, in one request over all T3 terms"),
], ["What", "How"])
```

## 6 · Pools {#pools}

**Why:** the test compares terms with general words, so the two sets must not differ in frequency or length.

```{python}
pr = (m6.get("dopasowanie") or {}).get("progi", {})
T([
    ("Subject pool", "all candidates labelled T3", ""),
    ("General pool", "all candidates labelled T1 or T2", ""),
    ("Matching", f"one general word per term: same part of speech, closest Zipf frequency and length; optimal assignment without "
                 f"reuse, within {num(pr.get('max_roznica_zipf'))} Zipf and {num(pr.get('max_roznica_liter'))} letters",
     f"{v('scipy')} (`linear_sum_assignment`)"),
    ("Worksheet", f"{cfg['zloty_zbior']['n']} candidates, stratified by label, for two annotators; model labels are not shown", v("openpyxl")),
], ["What", "How", "Tool"])
```

## 7 · Pseudowords {#pseudowords}

**Why:** the word-recognition test needs non-words that look and sound Polish and cannot be spotted by their shape.

Each pseudoword is tied to a **template**: one of `{python} num(p["n_szablonow"])` real nouns and verbs drawn from
the two pools. Each generator gives up to `{python} num(p["kandydatow_na_szablon"])` candidates per template.

```{python}
T([
    ("`wuggy_koncowka`", "replaces sub-syllabic segments of the template, keeps their lengths and the template's ending", f"{v('Wuggy')}, Polish plugin"),
    ("`wuggy`", "the same, ending free", v("Wuggy")),
    ("`unipseudo`", "letter-trigram chain built from real words of the same length and part of speech", "UniPseudo (Python port), WorldLex-Polish"),
    ("`llm`", "the model is given the template and asked for non-words with the same ending and number of syllables", M(llm["model_pseudoslow"])),
    ("`imbir`", f"published list, items accepted by at least {p['imbir_min_sedziow']} of 5 judges, paired by length", "Imbir et al. (2015)"),
], ["Generator", "How", "Tool or model"])
```

Hard filters; a candidate is rejected by the first one it fails:

```{python}
lex = m7.get("leksykon", {})
T([
    ("Existing word", "found in Morfeusz2, KWJP100, WorldLex, wordfreq or the corpus"),
    ("Shape", "length within one letter of the template, same number of syllables, same kind of ending"),
    ("Letter patterns", f"every trigram, onset, coda and consonant cluster occurs in at least {num(lex.get('min_typow_ngramu'))} "
                        f"of {num(lex.get('lematy_kwjp'))} Polish lemmas"),
    ("Too close to a word", f"one edit from the template or from a frequent word (Zipf ≥ {num(lex.get('prog_zipf'))}), or sounds like a word"),
    ("Transparent", "a real stem with a prefix or suffix, or two words joined"),
    ("Unsuitable", f"vulgar association; sounds like one of {num(lex.get('slowa_ua_ru'))} frequent Ukrainian or Russian words"),
], ["Filter", "Rule"])
```

Edit distances: `{python} v("rapidfuzz")`.

```{python}
thr = m7.get("progi_oceny", {})
T([
    ("Ranking", "within a template, by closeness to it in neighbourhood density (OLD20) and bigram probability"),
    ("Rating", f"{M(llm['model_oceny_pseudoslow'])} rates the top {p['ocenianych_na_szablon']} per template, at most half from one "
               "generator: pronounceability 1–5, similarity to a real word 0–3, and flags for existing, foreign and inappropriate"),
    ("Recommended list", f"pronounceability ≥ {num(thr.get('min_wymawialnosc'))}, similarity ≤ {num(thr.get('max_podobienstwo'))}, no flag; "
                         f"the best-ranked {p['wybrane_na_szablon']} per template"),
    ("Check", "templates and pseudowords compared on length, syllables, clusters, diacritics, OLD20, bigram probability"),
], ["What", "How"])
```

## Software

```{python}
use = {"spacy": "tagging", "pl_core_news_lg": "spaCy model for Polish", "morfeusz2": "lemmas, inflection, word check",
       "stanza": "comparison tagger; input of TermoPL", "wordfreq": "Zipf frequencies; Ukrainian and Russian word lists",
       "Wuggy": "pseudoword generator", "anthropic": "Claude API", "scipy": "matching, rank correlations",
       "rapidfuzz": "edit distances", "lxml": "HTML parsing", "pandas": "tables", "openpyxl": "worksheets"}
T([(f"`{name}`", ver.get(name, "–"), what) for name, what in use.items() if name in ver]
  + [("TermoPL", "8.1.1", "C-value (Java)"), ("Quarto", "1.9.36", "this site")], ["Package", "Version", "Used for"])
```
